title: Gadget Market — Admin Dashboard
tagline: The back office that runs the gadget shop
description: The admin dashboard behind the Gadget Market demo: "Needs your attention today", the order pipeline from pending to delivered with invoice PDFs, fake-order protection (🟢 Trusted / 🟡 New / 🔴 Verify), products with auto SKUs (GAD-EB-SON-BLK-0007) and a spec-sheet editor, combo bundles, stock lots by supplier invoice and a serial-number log printed on invoices, warranty claims from submitted to resolved, coupons, banners, reviews and Q&A, delivery zones, staff roles, reports and the activity log — in Bangla and English. It is the real admin code running in the browser, sharing its data with the shop demo.
highlights: Opens straight into the dashboard — no sign-in needed
COD orders can't be confirmed until the customer's call is logged — try it on a pending order
Serial numbers are picked per order line when packing and printed on the invoice
Invoice PDF, call and WhatsApp buttons on every order
Search by order no, invoice no, phone or SKU; CSV export on every list
42 fictional orders over nine weeks, so the charts and reports have something to show

credentials.label: Admin dashboard sign-in
credentials.note: Opens already signed in. After Sign out, sign back in with these (they are filled in for you). Staff can also sign in by phone: 01899999999 — the SMS code shows on screen. Everything is fictional demo data kept in your browser; add ?demo-reset to the address to start fresh.
